title: 2013 Honda Pilot Fender Replacement and Door Molding Repair
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair replaced the driver-side fender and refinished all four door moldings on a 2013 Honda Pilot in maroon.
story: This 2013 Honda Pilot came in for body repairs on the driver side. The driver-side front fender required replacement. After fitting the new fender panel, technicians aligned it with the hood and front door to match factory panel gaps.

All four side door moldings were damaged as well. The shop prepped, sanded, and repaired the existing moldings. Primer filler was applied to smooth out scratches and surface defects prior to painting.

The replacement fender and door moldings were sprayed to match the original maroon paint, followed by a clear coat application. After curing, the panels were reassembled and inspected for final delivery.
